en: I always goes with am.
tr: I her zaman am ile gelir.
fa: I همیشه با am می‌آید.

en: Ayşe and Can = they (more than one) → are.
tr: Ayşe ve Can = they (birden fazla) → are.
fa: Ayşe و Can یعنی they (بیش از یکی) → are.

en: Istanbul = it (one thing) → is.
tr: Istanbul = it (tek şey) → is.
fa: Istanbul یعنی it (یک چیز) → is.

en: Match the verb to the subject: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are.
tr: Fiili özneye uydur: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are.
fa: فعل را با فاعل هماهنگ کن: I am، he / she / it is، you / we / they are.

en: Write two short sentences about yourself: your name and where you are from.
tr: Kendin hakkında iki kısa cümle yaz: adın ve nereli olduğun.
fa: درباره خودت دو جمله کوتاه بنویس: اسمت و اهل کجا هستی.

en: Look at your verbs. Did you write am after I?
tr: Fiillerine bak. I'dan sonra am yazdın mı?
fa: به فعل‌هایت نگاه کن. بعد از I از am استفاده کردی؟

en: One woman → she.
tr: Bir kadın → she.
fa: یک زن → she.

en: A thing (not a person) → it.
tr: Bir şey (kişi değil) → it.
fa: یک چیز (نه آدم) → it.

en: Two people → they.
tr: İki kişi → they.
fa: دو نفر → they.

en: Use subject pronouns before the verb: he is, she is, they are (not him is, her is).
tr: Fiilden önce özne zamiri kullan: he is, she is, they are (him is, her is değil).
fa: قبل از فعل ضمیر فاعلی بگذار: he is، she is، they are (نه him is یا her is).

en: Write two sentences about two people you know. Start each with he, she or they.
tr: Tanıdığın iki kişi hakkında iki cümle yaz. Her birine he, she ya da they ile başla.
fa: درباره دو نفر که می‌شناسی دو جمله بنویس. هر جمله را با he، she یا they شروع کن.

en: Does each sentence start with a subject word?
tr: Her cümle bir özne kelimesiyle başlıyor mu?
fa: آیا هر جمله با یک فاعل شروع می‌شود؟

en: Irregular: child → children.
tr: Düzensiz: child → children.
fa: بی‌قاعده: child → children.

en: After -x, -s, -sh, -ch add -es.
tr: -x, -s, -sh, -ch sonrasında -es eklenir.
fa: بعد از -x، -s، -sh، -ch باید -es اضافه کرد.

en: Consonant + y becomes -ies: city → cities.
tr: Sessiz harf + y, -ies olur: city → cities.
fa: حرف بی‌صدا + y تبدیل به -ies می‌شود: city → cities.

en: Some plurals are irregular: child → children, man → men, woman → women, foot → feet, tooth → teeth.
tr: Bazı çoğullar düzensizdir: child → children, man → men, woman → women, foot → feet, tooth → teeth.
fa: بعضی جمع‌ها بی‌قاعده‌اند: child → children، man → men، woman → women، foot → feet، tooth → teeth.

en: Write two sentences about your family or friends. Use a number and a plural noun in each.
tr: Ailen ya da arkadaşların hakkında iki cümle yaz. Her cümlede bir sayı ve çoğul isim kullan.
fa: درباره خانواده یا دوستانت دو جمله بنویس. در هر جمله یک عدد و یک اسم جمع بگذار.

en: Look at your plural nouns. Is any of them irregular (children, men, women)?
tr: Çoğul isimlerine bak. Düzensiz olan var mı (children, men, women)?
fa: به اسم‌های جمعت نگاه کن. آیا بی‌قاعده‌ای هست (children، men، women)؟

en: Far + more than one → those.
tr: Uzak + birden fazla → those.
fa: دور + بیش از یکی → those.

en: Near + one → this.
tr: Yakın + tek → this.
fa: نزدیک + یکی → this.

en: Near + more than one → these.
tr: Yakın + birden fazla → these.
fa: نزدیک + بیش از یکی → these.

en: One thing: this / that + is. More than one: these / those + are.
tr: Tek şey: this / that + is. Birden fazla: these / those + are.
fa: یک چیز: this / that + is. بیش از یکی: these / those + are.

en: Look around you. Write one sentence about something near you and one about something far from you.
tr: Etrafına bak. Yakınındaki bir şey için bir cümle, uzağındaki bir şey için bir cümle yaz.
fa: به اطرافت نگاه کن. یک جمله درباره چیزی نزدیک و یک جمله درباره چیزی دور بنویس.

en: Near = this / these. Far = that / those. Does your verb match (is / are)?
tr: Yakın = this / these. Uzak = that / those. Fiilin uyuyor mu (is / are)?
fa: نزدیک = this / these. دور = that / those. فعلت (is / are) هماهنگ است؟

en: Consonant + y becomes -ies: study → studies.
tr: Sessiz harf + y, -ies olur: study → studies.
fa: حرف بی‌صدا + y تبدیل به -ies می‌شود: study → studies.

en: After -sh, -ch, -s, -x add -es.
tr: -sh, -ch, -s, -x sonrasında -es eklenir.
fa: بعد از -sh، -ch، -s، -x باید -es اضافه کرد.

en: "My friends" = they. No -s.
tr: "My friends" = they. -s yok.
fa: «My friends» یعنی they. بدون -s.

en: With he / she / it, the verb takes -s: he goes, she has, he does, she likes.
tr: he / she / it ile fiil -s alır: he goes, she has, he does, she likes.
fa: با he / she / it فعل -s می‌گیرد: he goes، she has، he does، she likes.

en: Write one sentence about someone you know and their day.
tr: Tanıdığın birini ve gününü anlatan bir cümle yaz.
fa: یک جمله درباره کسی که می‌شناسی و روزش بنویس.

en: Look at your verb. Does it end in -s?
tr: Fiiline bak. Sonunda -s var mı?
fa: به فعلت نگاه کن. آخرش -s دارد؟

en: you → your (it goes before the noun).
tr: you → your (isimden önce gelir).
fa: you ← your (قبل از اسم می‌آید).

en: Before a noun, use my, your, his, her, our, their (not me, you, he, she, they).
tr: İsimden önce my, your, his, her, our, their kullan (me, you, he, she, they değil).
fa: قبل از اسم از my، your، his، her، our، their استفاده کن (نه me، you، he، she، they).

en: Write two sentences about your family or your home. Use my in one and his, her or their in the other.
tr: Ailen ya da evin hakkında iki cümle yaz. Birinde my, diğerinde his, her ya da their kullan.
fa: درباره خانواده یا خانه‌ات دو جمله بنویس. در یکی از my و در دیگری از his، her یا their استفاده کن.

en: Does each small word (my, her, their...) match the owner?
tr: Her küçük kelime (my, her, their...) sahibine uyuyor mu?
fa: آیا هر کلمه کوچک (my، her، their...) با صاحبش هماهنگ است؟

en: One problem → there is.
tr: Tek sorun → there is.
fa: یک مشکل ← there is.

en: Many people → there are.
tr: Çok kişi → there are.
fa: افراد زیاد ← there are.

en: To ask if something exists: Is there...?
tr: Bir şeyin var olup olmadığını sormak için: Is there...?
fa: برای پرسیدن وجود چیزی: Is there...?

en: One thing: there is. More than one: there are (there are two cats, there are many people).
tr: Tek şey: there is. Birden fazla: there are (there are two cats, there are many people).
fa: یک چیز: there is. بیش از یکی: there are (there are two cats، there are many people).

en: Write two sentences about your street or your city. Say what there is and what there are.
tr: Sokağın ya da şehrin hakkında iki cümle yaz. Neler olduğunu there is ve there are ile söyle.
fa: درباره خیابان یا شهرت دو جمله بنویس. با there is و there are بگو چه چیزهایی هست.

en: One thing = there is. More than one = there are. Check each sentence.
tr: Tek şey = there is. Birden fazla = there are. Her cümleyi kontrol et.
fa: یک چیز = there is. بیش از یکی = there are. هر جمله را بررسی کن.

en: Inside a space: in.
tr: Bir alanın içinde: in.
fa: داخل یک فضا: in.

en: Touching the top of a surface: on.
tr: Bir yüzeyin üstünde, temas halinde: on.
fa: روی سطح و در تماس با آن: on.

en: Side by side: next to.
tr: Yan yana: next to.
fa: کنار هم: next to.

en: Use on for a surface: on the table, on the sofa, on the floor. Use in for inside a space: in the bag, in the room.
tr: Yüzey için on kullan: on the table, on the sofa, on the floor. Bir alanın içi için in: in the bag, in the room.
fa: برای سطح از on استفاده کن: on the table، on the sofa، on the floor. برای داخل یک فضا in: in the bag، in the room.

en: Look around your room. Write two sentences about where two things are.
tr: Odana bak. İki şeyin nerede olduğunu anlatan iki cümle yaz.
fa: به اتاقت نگاه کن. درباره اینکه دو چیز کجا هستند دو جمله بنویس.

en: Check your small word (in, on, under, next to). Does it match where the thing really is?
tr: Küçük kelimene bak (in, on, under, next to). Eşyanın gerçek yerine uyuyor mu?
fa: کلمه کوچکت را بررسی کن (in، on، under، next to). با جای واقعی چیز می‌خواند؟

en: Orange starts with a vowel sound → an.
tr: Orange ünlü sesle başlar → an.
fa: Orange با صدای مصوت شروع می‌شود → an.

en: University starts with the sound "you" (a consonant sound) → a.
tr: University "yu" sesiyle (ünsüz ses) başlar → a.
fa: University با صدای «یو» (صدای بی‌صدا) شروع می‌شود → a.

en: The h in hour is silent, so the word starts with a vowel sound → an.
tr: Hour'daki h okunmaz, kelime ünlü sesle başlar → an.
fa: h در hour خوانده نمی‌شود، پس کلمه با مصوت شروع می‌شود → an.

en: Look at the SOUND, not the letter: an apple, an hour, an honest man; a university, a house, a car.
tr: Harfe değil SESE bak: an apple, an hour, an honest man; a university, a house, a car.
fa: به صدا نگاه کن، نه به حرف: an apple، an hour، an honest man؛ a university، a house، a car.

en: Write two sentences: one about your job or studies, and one about something you have. Use a or an.
tr: İki cümle yaz: biri işin ya da okulun hakkında, biri sahip olduğun bir şey hakkında. a ya da an kullan.
fa: دو جمله بنویس: یکی درباره کار یا درست و یکی درباره چیزی که داری. از a یا an استفاده کن.

en: Look at the word after a / an. Does it start with a vowel sound? Then you need an.
tr: a / an'dan sonraki kelimeye bak. Ünlü sesle başlıyor mu? O zaman an gerekir.
fa: به کلمه بعد از a / an نگاه کن. با صدای مصوت شروع می‌شود؟ پس an لازم است.

en: To ask about a state or feeling: How?
tr: Durum ya da his sormak için: How?
fa: برای پرسیدن حال و حالت: How؟

en: "On Monday" is a time → When.
tr: "On Monday" bir zaman → When.
fa: «On Monday» یک زمان است ← When.

en: To ask about a place: Where?
tr: Yer sormak için: Where?
fa: برای پرسیدن مکان: Where؟

en: Question order: question word, then the helper verb, then the subject. Where are you? Where do you live? What time is it?
tr: Soru sırası: soru kelimesi, sonra yardımcı fiil, sonra özne. Where are you? Where do you live? What time is it?
fa: ترتیب سؤال: کلمه پرسشی، بعد فعل کمکی، بعد فاعل. Where are you؟ Where do you live؟ What time is it؟

en: You meet a new friend. Write two questions to ask them.
tr: Yeni bir arkadaşla tanışıyorsun. Ona sormak için iki soru yaz.
fa: با یک دوست جدید آشنا می‌شوی. دو سؤال برای پرسیدن از او بنویس.

en: Check the order: question word, then the helper verb (do / are / is), then the subject.
tr: Sırayı kontrol et: soru kelimesi, sonra yardımcı fiil (do / are / is), sonra özne.
fa: ترتیب را بررسی کن: کلمه پرسشی، بعد فعل کمکی (do / are / is)، بعد فاعل.

en: I → don't + the plain verb: don't have.
tr: I → don't + yalın fiil: don't have.
fa: I → don't + فعل ساده: don't have.

en: she → Does. The short answer says “she does”.
tr: she → Does. Kısa cevap “she does” diyor.
fa: she → Does. جواب کوتاه می‌گوید “she does”.

en: Short answer: No, he doesn't (no verb after it).
tr: Kısa cevap: No, he doesn't (arkasından fiil gelmez).
fa: جواب کوتاه: No, he doesn't (بعدش فعل نمی‌آید).

en: After does / doesn't, the verb has no -s: she doesn't like, does he work?
tr: does / doesn't'tan sonra fiil -s almaz: she doesn't like, does he work?
fa: بعد از does / doesn't فعل ‎-s نمی‌گیرد: she doesn't like، does he work?

en: To say no, use don't (I, you, we, they) or doesn't (he, she, it): I don't know, she doesn't know.
tr: Olumsuz için don't (I, you, we, they) ya da doesn't (he, she, it) kullan: I don't know, she doesn't know.
fa: برای منفی از don't (I، you، we، they) یا doesn't (he، she، it) استفاده کن: I don't know، she doesn't know.

en: Write two sentences: one thing you don't do on Sundays, and one question for a friend that starts with Do you...?
tr: İki cümle yaz: pazar günleri yapmadığın bir şey ve bir arkadaşına Do you...? ile başlayan bir soru.
fa: دو جمله بنویس: یک کاری که یکشنبه‌ها انجام نمی‌دهی، و یک سؤال برای یک دوست که با Do you...? شروع شود.

en: Check: don't / doesn't before the verb, and no -s after does / doesn't.
tr: Kontrol et: fiilden önce don't / doesn't var mı, does / doesn't'tan sonra -s yok mu?
fa: بررسی کن: قبل از فعل don't / doesn't گذاشتی؟ بعد از does / doesn't فعل بدون ‎-s است؟

en: Irregular: go → went.
tr: Düzensiz: go → went.
fa: بی‌قاعده: go ← went.

en: Regular verbs add -ed: play → played.
tr: Düzenli fiiller -ed alır: play → played.
fa: فعل‌های باقاعده -ed می‌گیرند: play ← played.

en: Irregular: have → had.
tr: Düzensiz: have → had.
fa: بی‌قاعده: have ← had.

en: Irregular verbs have their own past form: go → went, buy → bought, eat → ate, have → had. After did, use the base verb: did you go?
tr: Düzensiz fiillerin kendi geçmiş biçimi vardır: go → went, buy → bought, eat → ate, have → had. did'den sonra yalın fiil kullan: did you go?
fa: فعل‌های بی‌قاعده شکل گذشته خودشان را دارند: go ← went، buy ← bought، eat ← ate، have ← had. بعد از did فعل ساده بیاور: did you go؟

en: Write two sentences about what you did yesterday or last weekend.
tr: Dün ya da geçen hafta sonu ne yaptığını anlatan iki cümle yaz.
fa: درباره کاری که دیروز یا آخر هفته گذشته کردی دو جمله بنویس.

en: Look at each verb. Is it in the past? Irregular: go → went, have → had, eat → ate.
tr: Her fiile bak. Geçmiş zamanda mı? Düzensiz: go → went, have → had, eat → ate.
fa: به هر فعل نگاه کن. گذشته است؟ بی‌قاعده: go ← went، have ← had، eat ← ate.

en: After going to, use the base verb: visit (no -s, no -ing).
tr: going to'dan sonra yalın fiil kullan: visit (-s ve -ing yok).
fa: بعد از going to فعل ساده بیاور: visit (بدون -s و -ing).

en: Use am / is / are + going to + the base verb: I am going to visit, she is going to call.
tr: am / is / are + going to + yalın fiil kullan: I am going to visit, she is going to call.
fa: از am / is / are + going to + فعل ساده استفاده کن: I am going to visit، she is going to call.

en: Write two sentences about your plans for next weekend.
tr: Gelecek hafta sonu planların hakkında iki cümle yaz.
fa: درباره برنامه‌هایت برای آخر هفته آینده دو جمله بنویس.

en: Check each sentence: am / is / are + going to + the base verb.
tr: Her cümleyi kontrol et: am / is / are + going to + yalın fiil.
fa: هر جمله را بررسی کن: am / is / are + going to + فعل ساده.

en: Short adjective: add -er.
tr: Kısa sıfat: -er ekle.
fa: صفت کوتاه: -er اضافه کن.

en: Long adjective: more + adjective.
tr: Uzun sıfat: more + sıfat.
fa: صفت بلند: more + صفت.

en: One short vowel + one consonant: double the consonant. big → bigger.
tr: Tek kısa ünlü + tek ünsüz: ünsüz ikilenir. big → bigger.
fa: یک مصوت کوتاه + یک صامت: صامت دو برابر می‌شود. big ← bigger.

en: Use -er OR more, never both: taller, more expensive. Irregular: good → better, bad → worse.
tr: -er YA DA more kullan, ikisini birden değil: taller, more expensive. Düzensiz: good → better, bad → worse.
fa: یا -er یا more، نه هر دو: taller، more expensive. بی‌قاعده: good ← better، bad ← worse.

en: Compare two people, places or things you know. Write two sentences with than.
tr: Tanıdığın iki kişiyi, yeri ya da şeyi karşılaştır. than ile iki cümle yaz.
fa: دو نفر، مکان یا چیزی که می‌شناسی را مقایسه کن. دو جمله با than بنویس.

en: Short word: -er. Long word: more. Did you write than?
tr: Kısa kelime: -er. Uzun kelime: more. than yazdın mı?
fa: کلمه کوتاه: -er. کلمه بلند: more. آیا than نوشتی؟

en: Short adjective: the + -est.
tr: Kısa sıfat: the + -est.
fa: صفت کوتاه: the + est-

en: Irregular: good → better → best.
tr: Düzensiz: good → better → best.
fa: بی‌قاعده: good ← better ← best.

en: Long adjective: the most + adjective.
tr: Uzun sıfat: the most + sıfat.
fa: صفت بلند: the most + صفت.

en: Short adjective: the + -est (the biggest). Long adjective: the most + adjective (the most famous). Irregular: the best, the worst.
tr: Kısa sıfat: the + -est (the biggest). Uzun sıfat: the most + sıfat (the most famous). Düzensiz: the best, the worst.
fa: صفت کوتاه: the biggest. صفت بلند: the most + صفت (the most famous). بی‌قاعده: the best، the worst.

en: Write two sentences about the best, biggest or most interesting things in your life.
tr: Hayatındaki en iyi, en büyük ya da en ilginç şeyler hakkında iki cümle yaz.
fa: درباره بهترین، بزرگ‌ترین یا جالب‌ترین چیزها در زندگی‌ات دو جمله بنویس.

en: Did you write the before the superlative? Short word: -est. Long word: most.
tr: En üstünlük sıfatından önce the yazdın mı? Kısa kelime: -est. Uzun kelime: most.
fa: قبل از صفت عالی the نوشتی؟ کلمه کوتاه: est-. کلمه بلند: most.

en: Offers and requests with yes-answers: some.
tr: Teklif ve istek cümlelerinde: some.
fa: در پیشنهاد و درخواست: some.

en: Negative sentence: any.
tr: Olumsuz cümle: any.
fa: جمله منفی: any.

en: Question: any.
tr: Soru cümlesi: any.
fa: جمله پرسشی: any.

en: Some goes in yes-sentences and offers (I have some milk). Any goes in no-sentences and questions (I don't have any milk. Do you have any milk?).
tr: Some olumlu cümlelerde ve tekliflerde kullanılır (I have some milk). Any olumsuz cümle ve sorularda kullanılır (I don't have any milk. Do you have any milk?).
fa: some در جمله‌های مثبت و پیشنهاد می‌آید (I have some milk). any در جمله‌های منفی و پرسشی می‌آید (I don't have any milk. Do you have any milk?).

en: Write two sentences about your bag or your kitchen. Use some in one and any in the other.
tr: Çantan ya da mutfağın hakkında iki cümle yaz. Birinde some, diğerinde any kullan.
fa: درباره کیف یا آشپزخانه‌ات دو جمله بنویس. در یکی some و در دیگری any بگذار.

en: Some = yes-sentences and offers. Any = no-sentences and questions. Check each one.
tr: Some = olumlu cümle ve teklif. Any = olumsuz cümle ve soru. Her birini kontrol et.
fa: some = جمله مثبت و پیشنهاد. any = جمله منفی و پرسشی. هر کدام را بررسی کن.

en: Ability in the past: could.
tr: Geçmişteki yetenek: could.
fa: توانایی در گذشته: could.

en: A polite request: Can you...? / Could you...?
tr: Kibar rica: Can you...? / Could you...?
fa: درخواست مؤدبانه: Can you...؟ / Could you...؟

en: Not able to: can't.
tr: Yapamamak: can't.
fa: نمی‌تواند: can't.

en: After can / could, use the base verb: she can swim (no to, no -s, no -ing).
tr: can / could'dan sonra yalın fiil kullan: she can swim (to, -s, -ing yok).
fa: بعد از can / could فعل ساده بیاور: she can swim (بدون to، -s، -ing).

en: Write two sentences: one about something you can do now, and one about something you could do as a child.
tr: İki cümle yaz: biri şimdi yapabildiğin bir şey, biri çocukken yapabildiğin bir şey hakkında.
fa: دو جمله بنویس: یکی درباره کاری که الان می‌توانی بکنی و یکی درباره کاری که در کودکی می‌توانستی بکنی.

en: After can / could, is the verb in its base form (no to, no -s)?
tr: can / could'dan sonra fiil yalın halde mi (to ve -s yok)?
fa: بعد از can / could فعل به شکل ساده است (بدون to و -s)؟

en: Every day = always.
tr: Her gün = always.
fa: هر روز = always.

en: Zero times = never. After am / is / are, the word comes after the verb.
tr: Hiç = never. am / is / are'dan sonra gelir.
fa: هرگز = never. بعد از am / is / are می‌آید.

en: Not every time = sometimes.
tr: Her zaman değil = sometimes.
fa: نه همیشه = sometimes.

en: With am / is / are, the frequency word goes after: I am always late. With other verbs, it goes before: I always walk.
tr: am / is / are ile sıklık zarfı sonra gelir: I am always late. Diğer fiillerle önce gelir: I always walk.
fa: با am / is / are قید تکرار بعد از فعل می‌آید: I am always late. با فعل‌های دیگر قبل از آن می‌آید: I always walk.

en: Write two sentences about your habits. Use two different words from: always, usually, often, sometimes, never.
tr: Alışkanlıkların hakkında iki cümle yaz. Şunlardan iki farklı kelime kullan: always, usually, often, sometimes, never.
fa: درباره عادت‌هایت دو جمله بنویس. دو کلمه متفاوت از این‌ها بگذار: always، usually، often، sometimes، never.

en: With am / is / are, the word goes after it. With other verbs, it goes before. Check both sentences.
tr: am / is / are ile kelime sonra gelir. Diğer fiillerle önce gelir. İki cümleyi de kontrol et.
fa: با am / is / are کلمه بعد از آن می‌آید. با فعل‌های دیگر قبل از آن. هر دو جمله را بررسی کن.

en: is + verb-ing. Short vowel + one consonant: double it (run → running).
tr: is + fiil-ing. Kısa ünlü + tek ünsüz: ünsüz ikilenir (run → running).
fa: is + فعل-ing. مصوت کوتاه + یک صامت: صامت دو برابر می‌شود (run ← running).

en: are + verb-ing. Drop the e: have → having.
tr: are + fiil-ing. e düşer: have → having.
fa: are + فعل-ing. e حذف می‌شود: have ← having.

en: it → is + verb-ing.
tr: it → is + fiil-ing.
fa: it ← is + فعل-ing.

en: For an action happening now, use am / is / are + verb-ing: I am working, she is going.
tr: Şu anda olan bir eylem için am / is / are + fiil-ing kullan: I am working, she is going.
fa: برای کاری که همین الان انجام می‌شود از am / is / are + فعل-ing استفاده کن: I am working، she is going.

en: Write two sentences about what you and someone near you are doing right now.
tr: Şu anda senin ve yakınındaki birinin ne yaptığını anlatan iki cümle yaz.
fa: درباره کاری که الان تو و کسی نزدیکت انجام می‌دهید دو جمله بنویس.

en: Check each verb: am / is / are + verb-ing. Does it have both parts?
tr: Her fiili kontrol et: am / is / are + fiil-ing. İki parça da var mı?
fa: هر فعل را بررسی کن: am / is / are + فعل-ing. هر دو بخش را دارد؟

en: my parents = they → them (after the verb).
tr: my parents = they → them (fiilden sonra).
fa: my parents یعنی they ← them (بعد از فعل).

en: Ali = he → him (after the verb).
tr: Ali = he → him (fiilden sonra).
fa: Ali یعنی he ← him (بعد از فعل).

en: we → us (after the verb).
tr: we → us (fiilden sonra).
fa: we ← us (بعد از فعل).

en: After a verb or after to / for / with, use me, you, him, her, us, them (not I, he, she, we, they).
tr: Fiilden sonra ya da to / for / with'ten sonra me, you, him, her, us, them kullan (I, he, she, we, they değil).
fa: بعد از فعل یا بعد از to / for / with از me، you، him، her، us، them استفاده کن (نه I، he، she، we، they).

en: Write two sentences about people you know. Use him, her, them, me or us.
tr: Tanıdığın insanlar hakkında iki cümle yaz. him, her, them, me ya da us kullan.
fa: درباره آدم‌هایی که می‌شناسی دو جمله بنویس. از him، her، them، me یا us استفاده کن.

en: After the verb, did you use him, her, them, me, us (not he, she, they, I)?
tr: Fiilden sonra him, her, them, me, us kullandın mı (he, she, they, I değil)?
fa: بعد از فعل him، her، them، me، us گذاشتی (نه he، she، they، I)؟

en: A command uses the base verb: open.
tr: Emir cümlesi yalın fiil kullanır: open.
fa: جمله امری فعل ساده می‌گیرد: open.

en: The base form of am / is / are is be.
tr: am / is / are'ın yalın hali be'dir.
fa: شکل ساده am / is / are می‌شود be.

en: To say no to a command: Don't + base verb.
tr: Emri olumsuz yapmak için: Don't + yalın fiil.
fa: برای منفی کردن امر: Don't + فعل ساده.

en: A command uses the base verb, with no to and no -s: Sit down. For no, use Don't + base verb: Don't run.
tr: Emir cümlesi yalın fiil kullanır, to ve -s olmadan: Sit down. Olumsuz için Don't + yalın fiil: Don't run.
fa: جمله امری فعل ساده می‌گیرد، بدون to و -s: Sit down. برای منفی Don't + فعل ساده: Don't run.

en: You have a visitor in your city. Write two instructions for them. Use Don't in one.
tr: Şehrine bir misafir geldi. Ona iki talimat yaz. Birinde Don't kullan.
fa: یک مهمان به شهرت آمده است. دو دستور برایش بنویس. در یکی از Don't استفاده کن.

en: Does each command start with the base verb? Did you use Don't for the negative one?
tr: Her emir yalın fiille başlıyor mu? Olumsuz için Don't kullandın mı?
fa: هر دستور با فعل ساده شروع می‌شود؟ برای منفی از Don't استفاده کردی؟

en: Yesterday = finished time → past simple.
tr: Yesterday = bitmiş zaman → past simple.
fa: Yesterday یعنی زمان تمام‌شده ← گذشته ساده.

en: "In my life" is still open → have + never + past participle.
tr: "In my life" hâlâ açık bir süre → have + never + past participle.
fa: «در زندگی‌ام» هنوز تمام نشده ← have + never + اسم مفعول.

en: "Yet" is a present perfect signal.
tr: "Yet" present perfect sinyalidir.
fa: «yet» نشانه حال کامل است.

en: With a finished time (yesterday, last week, in 2019) use past simple: I saw, I met, I went. Keep have + past participle for open time: ever, never, yet, so far.
tr: Bitmiş bir zamanla (yesterday, last week, in 2019) past simple kullan: I saw, I met, I went. have + past participle açık zamanlar içindir: ever, never, yet, so far.
fa: با زمان تمام‌شده (yesterday، last week، in 2019) گذشته ساده بگو: I saw، I met، I went. have + اسم مفعول برای زمان باز است: ever، never، yet، so far.

en: Write two sentences: one thing you have done in your life (no time), and when you did it (with a time).
tr: İki cümle yaz: hayatında yaptığın bir şey (zaman belirtmeden) ve onu ne zaman yaptığın (zamanla).
fa: دو جمله بنویس: یک کاری که در زندگی‌ات کرده‌ای (بدون زمان) و این‌که کی انجامش دادی (با زمان).

en: Does your sentence with a time word use past simple, not have?
tr: Zaman kelimesi olan cümlende have değil past simple var mı?
fa: جمله‌ای که زمان دارد، گذشته ساده است، نه با have؟

en: Six months = a length of time → for.
tr: Six months = bir süre → for.
fa: شش ماه یعنی طول مدت ← for.

en: Last March = a starting point → since.
tr: Last March = başlangıç noktası → since.
fa: مارس گذشته یعنی نقطه شروع ← since.

en: "A long time" is a length → for.
tr: "A long time" bir süre → for.
fa: «مدت زیادی» طول مدت است ← for.

en: since + a starting point (since 2019, since Monday); for + a length of time (for two years, for a long time).
tr: since + başlangıç noktası (since 2019, since Monday); for + süre (for two years, for a long time).
fa: since + نقطه شروع (since 2019، since Monday)؛ for + طول مدت (for two years، for a long time).

en: Write two sentences about something in your life: one with since and one with for.
tr: Hayatındaki bir şey hakkında iki cümle yaz: biri since ile, biri for ile.
fa: درباره چیزی در زندگی‌ات دو جمله بنویس: یکی با since و یکی با for.

en: After since, is there a point in time? After for, a length of time?
tr: since'ten sonra bir zaman noktası, for'dan sonra bir süre var mı?
fa: بعد از since یک زمان مشخص و بعد از for یک طول مدت آمده؟

en: The if-part stays present simple, even for the future.
tr: If kısmı gelecek için bile present simple kalır.
fa: بخش if حتی برای آینده حال ساده می‌ماند.

en: The result part takes will.
tr: Sonuç kısmı will alır.
fa: بخش نتیجه will می‌گیرد.

en: After if: present simple. They → are.
tr: if'ten sonra present simple. They → are.
fa: بعد از if حال ساده. They ← are.

en: No will after if: If it rains, I will stay. Present simple in the if-part, will in the result.
tr: if'ten sonra will yok: If it rains, I will stay. If kısmında present simple, sonuçta will.
fa: بعد از if از will استفاده نکن: If it rains, I will stay. در بخش if حال ساده، در نتیجه will.

en: Write one sentence about your plans for this weekend with if.
tr: if kullanarak bu hafta sonu planların hakkında bir cümle yaz.
fa: با if یک جمله درباره برنامه آخر هفته‌ات بنویس.

en: Is there no will right after if?
tr: if'ten hemen sonra will yok, değil mi?
fa: بعد از if بلافاصله will نیامده؟

en: A strong personal obligation → must + base verb.
tr: Güçlü kişisel zorunluluk → must + yalın fiil.
fa: الزام قوی شخصی ← must + فعل ساده.

en: She → has to (have to is a normal verb).
tr: She → has to (have to normal bir fiildir).
fa: She ← has to (have to فعل معمولی است).

en: Negative advice: should not + base verb.
tr: Olumsuz tavsiye: should not + yalın fiil.
fa: توصیه منفی: should not + فعل ساده.

en: must and should are modals: no to after them (must go, should see). Only have to keeps to: I have to go.
tr: must ve should modal fiildir: sonrasında to yok (must go, should see). Sadece have to'da to kalır: I have to go.
fa: must و should فعل کمکی‌اند: بعدشان to نمی‌آید (must go، should see). فقط have to با to است: I have to go.

en: Write two sentences: one rule at your work or school (have to) and one piece of advice for a new colleague (should).
tr: İki cümle yaz: işinde ya da okulunda bir kural (have to) ve yeni bir iş arkadaşına bir tavsiye (should).
fa: دو جمله بنویس: یک قانون در محل کار یا مدرسه‌ات (have to) و یک توصیه به همکار جدید (should).

en: Is there no to after must or should?
tr: must veya should'dan sonra to yok mu?
fa: بعد از must یا should، to نیامده؟

en: be + past participle: sing → sung. 1995 → was.
tr: be + past participle: sing → sung. 1995 → was.
fa: be + اسم مفعول: sing ← sung. سال ۱۹۹۵ ← was.

en: Rooms = plural, every morning = present → are cleaned.
tr: Rooms çoğul, every morning şimdiki zaman → are cleaned.
fa: Rooms جمع است، every morning حال است ← are cleaned.

en: Last night → was + stolen (steal, stole, stolen).
tr: Last night → was + stolen (steal, stole, stolen).
fa: Last night ← was + stolen (steal، stole، stolen).

en: Passive = be + past participle (third form): was sent, was written, was broken, was taken, is sold, was built, was stolen.
tr: Edilgen = be + past participle (üçüncü hali): was sent, was written, was broken, was taken, is sold, was built, was stolen.
fa: مجهول = be + اسم مفعول (شکل سوم): was sent، was written، was broken، was taken، is sold، was built، was stolen.

en: Write one passive sentence about a thing you own: when or where it was made, bought or given.
tr: Sahip olduğun bir şey hakkında edilgen bir cümle yaz: ne zaman ya da nerede yapıldı, alındı ya da verildi.
fa: درباره چیزی که داری یک جمله مجهول بنویس: کی یا کجا ساخته، خریده یا هدیه داده شده.

en: Do you have be (was/were/is/are) + the third form of the verb?
tr: be (was/were/is/are) + fiilin üçüncü hali var mı?
fa: be (was/were/is/are) + شکل سوم فعل را داری؟

en: A person → who (or that).
tr: Kişi → who (ya da that).
fa: برای شخص ← who (یا that).

en: A thing → which (or that).
tr: Bir şey → which (ya da that).
fa: برای چیز ← which (یا that).

en: Possession (her class) → whose.
tr: Sahiplik (onun dersi) → whose.
fa: مالکیت (کلاسِ او) ← whose.

en: who is for people, which is for things; that works for both: the man who called, the book which I read.
tr: who insanlar için, which şeyler için; that ikisi için de olur: the man who called, the book which I read.
fa: who برای آدم‌ها، which برای چیزها؛ that برای هر دو: the man who called، the book which I read.

en: Write one sentence about a person and one about a thing in your life, each with a relative clause.
tr: Hayatındaki bir kişi ve bir şey hakkında, her biri ilgi cümleciği içeren birer cümle yaz.
fa: درباره یک نفر و یک چیز در زندگی‌ات، هرکدام با یک جمله‌واره موصولی بنویس.

en: Did you use who for the person and which or that for the thing?
tr: Kişi için who, şey için which ya da that kullandın mı?
fa: برای شخص who و برای چیز which یا that به کار بردی؟

en: used to + base verb, same for every subject.
tr: used to + yalın fiil, her özne için aynı.
fa: used to + فعل ساده، برای همه فاعل‌ها یکسان.

en: Negative: did not use to (no d, because did carries the past).
tr: Olumsuz: did not use to (did geçmişi taşıdığı için d yok).
fa: منفی: did not use to (بدون d، چون did گذشته را نشان می‌دهد).

en: Question: Did you use to ...?
tr: Soru: Did you use to ...?
fa: سؤال: Did you use to ...?

en: Past habit: used to + base verb (I used to live). After did, drop the d: Did you use to? I didn't use to.
tr: Geçmiş alışkanlık: used to + yalın fiil (I used to live). did'den sonra d düşer: Did you use to? I didn't use to.
fa: عادت گذشته: used to + فعل ساده (I used to live). بعد از did حرف d می‌افتد: Did you use to? I didn't use to.

en: Write two sentences about your childhood with used to: one thing you did, one thing you didn't do.
tr: used to ile çocukluğun hakkında iki cümle yaz: yaptığın bir şey ve yapmadığın bir şey.
fa: با used to دو جمله درباره کودکی‌ات بنویس: یک کاری که می‌کردی و یک کاری که نمی‌کردی.

en: Is the verb after used to in its base form?
tr: used to'dan sonraki fiil yalın halde mi?
fa: فعل بعد از used to ساده است؟

en: hope + to + verb.
tr: hope + to + fiil.
fa: hope + to + فعل.

en: enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, suggest + -ing (enjoy swimming). want, decide, hope, plan, agree + to (want to go).
tr: enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, suggest + -ing (enjoy swimming). want, decide, hope, plan, agree + to (want to go).
fa: enjoy، avoid، finish، mind، suggest + ‎-ing (enjoy swimming). want، decide، hope، plan، agree + to (want to go).

en: Write two sentences about your free time: one with enjoy or avoid, one with want or hope.
tr: Boş zamanın hakkında iki cümle yaz: biri enjoy ya da avoid ile, biri want ya da hope ile.
fa: درباره وقت آزادت دو جمله بنویس: یکی با enjoy یا avoid و یکی با want یا hope.

en: After enjoy or avoid, is the verb -ing? After want or hope, is there to?
tr: enjoy veya avoid'dan sonra fiil -ing mi? want veya hope'tan sonra to var mı?
fa: بعد از enjoy یا avoid فعل ‎-ing دارد؟ بعد از want یا hope، to آمده؟

en: Positive can → negative tag: can't we.
tr: Olumlu can → olumsuz kuyruk: can't we.
fa: can مثبت ← دنباله منفی: can't we.

en: Normal verb, she → doesn't she.
tr: Normal fiil, she → doesn't she.
fa: فعل معمولی، she ← doesn't she.

en: Negative statement → positive tag: did you.
tr: Olumsuz cümle → olumlu kuyruk: did you.
fa: جمله منفی ← دنباله مثبت: did you.

en: The tag repeats the subject and the auxiliary of the sentence, with the opposite polarity: You're coming, aren't you? He works here, doesn't he? Not a fixed isn't it.
tr: Kuyruk, cümlenin öznesini ve yardımcı fiilini ters kutupla tekrarlar: You're coming, aren't you? He works here, doesn't he? Sabit isn't it değil.
fa: دنباله، فاعل و فعل کمکیِ همان جمله را با قطب مخالف تکرار می‌کند: You're coming, aren't you? He works here, doesn't he? نه یک isn't it ثابت.

en: Write two questions with tags that you could ask a colleague today.
tr: Bugün bir iş arkadaşına sorabileceğin, kuyruk sorulu iki soru yaz.
fa: دو سؤال با دنباله بنویس که امروز می‌توانی از همکارت بپرسی.

en: Does each tag use the same subject and auxiliary as the sentence, flipped?
tr: Her kuyruk, cümledeki özne ve yardımcı fiili ters çevirerek kullanıyor mu?
fa: هر دنباله همان فاعل و فعل کمکی جمله را برعکس به کار برده؟

en: Present simple → past simple: work → worked.
tr: Present simple → past simple: work → worked.
fa: حال ساده ← گذشته ساده: work ← worked.

en: After said / told (past), shift the tense back: is → was, are → were, will → would, can → could. She said she was tired.
tr: said / told (geçmiş) sonrasında zamanı geri çek: is → was, are → were, will → would, can → could. She said she was tired.
fa: بعد از said / told (گذشته) زمان را یک قدم عقب ببر: is ← was، are ← were، will ← would، can ← could. She said she was tired.

en: Think of something a friend told you this week. Report it in one sentence with said or told me.
tr: Bu hafta bir arkadaşının sana söylediği bir şeyi düşün. said ya da told me ile tek cümlede aktar.
fa: چیزی را که این هفته یک دوست به تو گفت به خاطر بیاور. با said یا told me در یک جمله نقل کن.

en: Did the verb move one step into the past?
tr: Fiil bir adım geçmişe kaydı mı?
fa: فعل یک قدم به گذشته رفت؟

en: If + past simple: had.
tr: If + past simple: had.
fa: If + گذشته ساده: had.

en: Result: would + base verb.
tr: Sonuç: would + yalın fiil.
fa: نتیجه: would + فعل ساده.

en: know → knew (unreal present).
tr: know → knew (gerçek dışı şimdi).
fa: know ← knew (حالِ غیرواقعی).

en: Unreal present: if + past simple, would + verb. If I had more time, I would travel. If I were you... No would and no will in the if-part.
tr: Gerçek dışı şimdi: if + past simple, would + fiil. If I had more time, I would travel. If I were you... If kısmında would ve will yok.
fa: حال غیرواقعی: if + گذشته ساده، would + فعل. If I had more time, I would travel. If I were you... در بخش if نه would می‌آید نه will.

en: Write one sentence about something you would change in your life if you could.
tr: Yapabilsen hayatında değiştireceğin bir şey hakkında bir cümle yaz.
fa: یک جمله بنویس درباره چیزی که اگر می‌توانستی در زندگی‌ات تغییر می‌دادی.

en: Past simple after if, would in the result?
tr: if'ten sonra past simple, sonuçta would var mı?
fa: بعد از if گذشته ساده و در نتیجه would آمده؟

en: If + past perfect: had seen.
tr: If + past perfect: had seen.
fa: If + گذشته کامل: had seen.

en: would have + past participle: won.
tr: would have + past participle: won.
fa: would have + اسم مفعول: won.

en: Negative past perfect: had not missed.
tr: Olumsuz past perfect: had not missed.
fa: گذشته کامل منفی: had not missed.

en: Past regret: if + had + past participle, would have + past participle. If I had known, I would have come. Both halves stay in the past.
tr: Geçmiş pişmanlık: if + had + past participle, would have + past participle. If I had known, I would have come. İki taraf da geçmişte kalır.
fa: حسرت گذشته: if + had + اسم مفعول، would have + اسم مفعول. If I had known, I would have come. هر دو بخش در گذشته می‌مانند.

en: Write one sentence about a small regret from last year with the third conditional.
tr: Geçen yıldan küçük bir pişmanlığını üçüncü tip koşul cümlesiyle yaz.
fa: درباره یک حسرت کوچک از پارسال یک جمله با شرطی نوع سوم بنویس.

en: had + past participle after if, would have + past participle in the result?
tr: if'ten sonra had + past participle, sonuçta would have + past participle var mı?
fa: بعد از if حرف had + اسم مفعول و در نتیجه would have + اسم مفعول آمده؟

en: Right now → is being + past participle.
tr: Right now → is being + past participle.
fa: همین الان ← is being + اسم مفعول.

en: Modal + be + past participle.
tr: Modal + be + past participle.
fa: فعل کمکی + be + اسم مفعول.

en: Past continuous passive: were being checked.
tr: Geçmiş sürekli edilgen: were being checked.
fa: مجهول گذشته استمراری: were being checked.

en: Modal passive: will / must / can / should + be + past participle: will be finished, must be signed, can be downloaded. With be in progress: is being repaired.
tr: Modal edilgen: will / must / can / should + be + past participle: will be finished, must be signed, can be downloaded. Süreçte: is being repaired.
fa: مجهول با فعل کمکی: will / must / can / should + be + اسم مفعول: will be finished، must be signed، can be downloaded. در جریان: is being repaired.

en: Write one sentence about something that will be done or must be done at your work, school or home this week.
tr: Bu hafta işinde, okulunda ya da evinde yapılacak ya da yapılması gereken bir şey hakkında bir cümle yaz.
fa: درباره کاری که این هفته در محل کار، مدرسه یا خانه‌ات انجام خواهد شد یا باید انجام شود یک جمله بنویس.

en: Is there a bare be between the modal and the past participle?
tr: Modal ile past participle arasında yalın bir be var mı?
fa: بین فعل کمکی و اسم مفعول یک be ساده هست؟

en: Negative command: told + not to + verb.
tr: Olumsuz emir: told + not to + fiil.
fa: دستور منفی: told + not to + فعل.

en: is → was, and statement order: the station was.
tr: is → was ve düz cümle sırası: the station was.
fa: is ← was و ترتیب جمله خبری: the station was.

en: Yes/no question → if or whether.
tr: Evet/hayır sorusu → if ya da whether.
fa: سؤال بله/خیر ← if یا whether.

en: Reported question: statement word order and backshift: She asked where I lived. Yes/no: asked if I was... Command: told me (not) to + verb.
tr: Aktarılan soru: düz cümle sırası ve zaman kaydırma: She asked where I lived. Evet/hayır: asked if I was... Emir: told me (not) to + fiil.
fa: سؤال نقل‌شده: ترتیب جمله خبری و عقب‌بردن زمان: She asked where I lived. بله/خیر: asked if I was... دستور: told me (not) to + فعل.

en: Report one question and one instruction someone gave you recently (asked me... / told me to...).
tr: Son zamanlarda birinin sana sorduğu bir soruyu ve verdiği bir talimatı aktar (asked me... / told me to...).
fa: یک سؤال و یک دستوری را که اخیراً کسی به تو داد نقل کن (asked me... / told me to...).

en: After asked, is the word order a statement, not a question?
tr: asked'tan sonra kelime sırası soru değil düz cümle mi?
fa: بعد از asked ترتیب کلمات مثل جمله خبری است، نه سؤالی؟

en: Possibility about the past: may / might have + past participle.
tr: Geçmişle ilgili olasılık: may / might have + past participle.
fa: احتمال درباره گذشته: may / might have + اسم مفعول.

en: Near certainty: must have + forgotten.
tr: Neredeyse kesin: must have + forgotten.
fa: تقریباً قطعی: must have + forgotten.

en: Logically impossible in the past: can't have + seen.
tr: Geçmişte mantıken imkânsız: can't have + seen.
fa: در گذشته منطقاً غیرممکن: can't have + seen.

en: Guessing about the past: must / might / may / can't + have + past participle: must have left, might have forgotten. Use can't have (not mustn't have) for impossible.
tr: Geçmiş hakkında tahmin: must / might / may / can't + have + past participle: must have left, might have forgotten. İmkânsız için can't have (mustn't have değil).
fa: حدس درباره گذشته: must / might / may / can't + have + اسم مفعول: must have left، might have forgotten. برای غیرممکن can't have (نه mustn't have).

en: A friend didn't come to your meeting and didn't call. Write two guesses: one with must have and one with might have.
tr: Bir arkadaşın buluşmaya gelmedi ve aramadı. İki tahmin yaz: biri must have, biri might have ile.
fa: دوستت به قرار نیامد و زنگ هم نزد. دو حدس بنویس: یکی با must have و یکی با might have.

en: Is there have + past participle after each modal?
tr: Her modal'dan sonra have + past participle var mı?
fa: بعد از هر فعل کمکی have + اسم مفعول آمده؟

en: Little + did + subject + base verb.
tr: Little + did + özne + yalın fiil.
fa: Little + did + فاعل + فعل ساده.

en: Rarely + does + subject + base verb.
tr: Rarely + does + özne + yalın fiil.
fa: Rarely + does + فاعل + فعل ساده.

en: Not only + was + subject. Be needs no do.
tr: Not only + was + özne. Be fiili do almaz.
fa: Not only + was + فاعل. be به do نیاز ندارد.

en: After a negative opener (Never, Rarely, Seldom, Little, Not only, Not until), put the auxiliary before the subject: Never have I seen... Rarely do we eat out.
tr: Olumsuz bir açılıştan (Never, Rarely, Seldom, Little, Not only, Not until) sonra yardımcı fiili öznenin önüne koy: Never have I seen... Rarely do we eat out.
fa: بعد از آغاز منفی (Never، Rarely، Seldom، Little، Not only، Not until) فعل کمکی را قبل از فاعل بگذار: Never have I seen... Rarely do we eat out.

en: Write one dramatic sentence about an experience, starting with Never or Rarely.
tr: Never ya da Rarely ile başlayan, bir deneyimi anlatan çarpıcı bir cümle yaz.
fa: یک جمله تأثیرگذار درباره یک تجربه بنویس که با Never یا Rarely شروع شود.

en: Does the auxiliary (have / do / did) come before the subject?
tr: Yardımcı fiil (have / do / did) özneden önce mi geliyor?
fa: فعل کمکی (have / do / did) قبل از فاعل آمده؟

en: run into = meet by chance.
tr: run into = tesadüfen karşılaşmak.
fa: run into = اتفاقی دیدن.

en: turn down = make quieter.
tr: turn down = sesini kısmak.
fa: turn down = صدا را کم کردن.

en: get over = recover from.
tr: get over = atlatmak.
fa: get over = بهبود یافتن.

en: Many phrasal verbs need one exact particle: look into a problem, get away with something, put up with noise, run into a friend, get rid of boxes, look forward to.
tr: Birçok öbek fiil tek bir doğru edat ister: look into a problem, get away with something, put up with noise, run into a friend, get rid of boxes, look forward to.
fa: خیلی از افعال عبارتی یک حرف اضافه دقیق می‌خواهند: look into a problem، get away with something، put up with noise، run into a friend، get rid of boxes، look forward to.

en: Write two sentences about your week using two of these: look into, put off, come across, get over, run into.
tr: Şunlardan ikisini kullanarak haftan hakkında iki cümle yaz: look into, put off, come across, get over, run into.
fa: با دو تا از این‌ها دو جمله درباره هفته‌ات بنویس: look into، put off، come across، get over، run into.

en: Is each particle the exact one that the phrasal verb needs?
tr: Her edat, öbek fiilin gerektirdiği tam edat mı?
fa: هر حرف اضافه دقیقاً همانی است که فعل عبارتی لازم دارد؟

en: Present wish: can → could.
tr: Şimdiki dilek: can → could.
fa: آرزوی حال: can ← could.

en: Past regret: had not + past participle.
tr: Geçmiş pişmanlık: had not + past participle.
fa: حسرت گذشته: had not + اسم مفعول.

en: Complaint about others: wish + would.
tr: Başkalarından şikâyet: wish + would.
fa: گلایه از دیگران: wish + would.

en: Present wish: wish + past simple (I wish I had, I wish I were, I wish I could). Past regret: wish + had + past participle (I wish I had studied). Complaint: wish + would.
tr: Şimdiki dilek: wish + past simple (I wish I had, I wish I were, I wish I could). Geçmiş pişmanlık: wish + had + past participle (I wish I had studied). Şikâyet: wish + would.
fa: آرزوی حال: wish + گذشته ساده (I wish I had، I wish I were، I wish I could). حسرت گذشته: wish + had + اسم مفعول (I wish I had studied). گلایه: wish + would.

en: Write two wishes: one about your life now, one about something in the past.
tr: İki dilek yaz: biri şimdiki hayatın, biri geçmişteki bir şey hakkında.
fa: دو آرزو بنویس: یکی درباره زندگی الانت و یکی درباره چیزی در گذشته.

en: Past simple for the present wish, had + past participle for the past one?
tr: Şimdiki dilek için past simple, geçmiş için had + past participle mi?
fa: برای آرزوی حال گذشته ساده و برای گذشته had + اسم مفعول نوشتی؟

en: Between commas, a thing → which (never that).
tr: Virgüller arasında, bir şey → which (asla that).
fa: بین دو ویرگول، برای چیز ← which (هرگز that).

en: Between commas, a person → who.
tr: Virgüller arasında, bir kişi → who.
fa: بین دو ویرگول، برای شخص ← who.

en: Possession → whose.
tr: Sahiplik → whose.
fa: مالکیت ← whose.

en: Between commas (extra information) use who or which, never that; and do not repeat the subject: My car, which is new, broke down.
tr: Virgüller arasında (ek bilgi) who ya da which kullan, asla that; özneyi tekrarlama: My car, which is new, broke down.
fa: بین دو ویرگول (اطلاعات اضافه) از who یا which استفاده کن، هرگز that؛ و فاعل را تکرار نکن: My car, which is new, broke down.

en: Write one sentence about a family member with extra information between commas.
tr: Bir aile üyen hakkında, virgüller arasında ek bilgi içeren bir cümle yaz.
fa: درباره یکی از اعضای خانواده‌ات یک جمله بنویس که بین دو ویرگول اطلاعات اضافه داشته باشد.

en: Is the extra information wrapped in two commas, with who or which?
tr: Ek bilgi iki virgül arasında, who ya da which ile mi?
fa: اطلاعات اضافه بین دو ویرگول و با who یا which آمده؟

en: A result → Therefore / As a result.
tr: Sonuç → Therefore / As a result.
fa: نتیجه ← Therefore / As a result.

en: Before a noun or -ing: Despite / In spite of.
tr: İsim ya da -ing öncesinde: Despite / In spite of.
fa: قبل از اسم یا ‎-ing: Despite / In spite of.

en: Formal contrast between two sentences: Nevertheless / However.
tr: İki cümle arasında resmi karşıtlık: Nevertheless / However.
fa: تضاد رسمی بین دو جمله: Nevertheless / However.

en: despite / in spite of + noun or -ing (despite the rain); although + clause (although it rained); however / nevertheless start a new sentence or follow a semicolon, with a comma after them.
tr: despite / in spite of + isim ya da -ing (despite the rain); although + cümle (although it rained); however / nevertheless yeni cümle başlatır ya da noktalı virgülden sonra gelir, ardından virgül.
fa: despite / in spite of + اسم یا ‎-ing (despite the rain)؛ although + جمله (although it rained)؛ however / nevertheless جمله جدید را شروع می‌کنند یا بعد از نقطه‌ویرگول می‌آیند و بعدشان ویرگول است.

en: Write three short sentences about your city: one with however, one with therefore, one with despite.
tr: Şehrin hakkında üç kısa cümle yaz: biri however, biri therefore, biri despite ile.
fa: درباره شهرت سه جمله کوتاه بنویس: یکی با however، یکی با therefore و یکی با despite.

en: Is there a comma after however and therefore? A noun after despite?
tr: however ve therefore'dan sonra virgül, despite'tan sonra isim var mı?
fa: بعد از however و therefore ویرگول و بعد از despite اسم آمده؟

en: Not only + does + subject + base verb.
tr: Not only + does + özne + yalın fiil.
fa: Not only + does + فاعل + فعل ساده.

en: Only later + did + subject + base verb.
tr: Only later + did + özne + yalın fiil.
fa: Only later + did + فاعل + فعل ساده.

en: At no time + were + subject.
tr: At no time + were + özne.
fa: At no time + were + فاعل.

en: After Not only / No sooner / Only later / Under no circumstances / At no time, the auxiliary comes before the subject: Not only did she arrive late... No sooner had we sat down than...
tr: Not only / No sooner / Only later / Under no circumstances / At no time'dan sonra yardımcı fiil özneden önce gelir: Not only did she arrive late... No sooner had we sat down than...
fa: بعد از Not only / No sooner / Only later / Under no circumstances / At no time فعل کمکی قبل از فاعل می‌آید: Not only did she arrive late... No sooner had we sat down than...

en: Write one sentence about a busy day using Not only ... but also, or No sooner ... than.
tr: Not only ... but also ya da No sooner ... than kullanarak yoğun bir günün hakkında bir cümle yaz.
fa: با Not only ... but also یا No sooner ... than یک جمله درباره یک روز شلوغ بنویس.

en: Does the auxiliary (did / had / does) come right after the opening phrase?
tr: Yardımcı fiil (did / had / does) açılış ifadesinin hemen ardından mı geliyor?
fa: فعل کمکی (did / had / does) درست بعد از عبارت آغازین آمده؟

en: Wh-cleft: What + clause + is + the stressed part.
tr: Wh-cleft: What + cümlecik + is + vurgulanan kısım.
fa: جمله شکافته با What: What + جمله‌واره + is + بخش تأکیدشده.

en: It-cleft: It was + stressed part + that.
tr: It-cleft: It was + vurgulanan kısım + that.
fa: جمله شکافته با It: It was + بخش تأکیدشده + that.

en: What she did was + base verb.
tr: What she did was + yalın fiil.
fa: What she did was + فعل ساده.

en: Cleft sentences: What I need is more time (no extra it). It was John who called (no repeated subject).
tr: Cleft cümleler: What I need is more time (fazladan it yok). It was John who called (özne tekrarı yok).
fa: جمله‌های شکافته: What I need is more time (بدون it اضافه). It was John who called (بدون تکرار فاعل).

en: Write two sentences about what you like most about your job or studies: one starting with What, one with It was / It is.
tr: İşinde ya da eğitiminde en sevdiğin şey hakkında iki cümle yaz: biri What ile, biri It was / It is ile başlasın.
fa: درباره چیزی که در کار یا درست بیشتر دوست داری دو جمله بنویس: یکی با What و یکی با It was / It is شروع شود.

en: After What + clause, did you go straight to is, with no extra it?
tr: What + cümlecikten sonra fazladan it olmadan doğrudan is'e geçtin mi?
fa: بعد از What + جمله‌واره، مستقیم is آمده، بدون it اضافه؟

en: Past criticism: should have been + past participle.
tr: Geçmiş eleştirisi: should have been + past participle.
fa: انتقاد از گذشته: should have been + اسم مفعول.

en: Possibility about the past, passive: might have been + past participle.
tr: Geçmiş olasılık, edilgen: might have been + past participle.
fa: احتمال درباره گذشته، مجهول: might have been + اسم مفعول.

en: Present rule, passive: must be + past participle.
tr: Şimdiki kural, edilgen: must be + past participle.
fa: قانون حال، مجهول: must be + اسم مفعول.

en: Modal passive: should / could / must + be + past participle for now (must be signed); should / could + have been + past participle for the past (should have been sent).
tr: Modal edilgen: şimdi için should / could / must + be + past participle (must be signed); geçmiş için should / could + have been + past participle (should have been sent).
fa: مجهول با فعل کمکی: برای حال should / could / must + be + اسم مفعول (must be signed)؛ برای گذشته should / could + have been + اسم مفعول (should have been sent).

en: Think of a service that disappointed you. Write one sentence about what should have been done.
tr: Seni hayal kırıklığına uğratan bir hizmeti düşün. Ne yapılmış olması gerektiğine dair bir cümle yaz.
fa: به خدماتی فکر کن که ناامیدت کرد. یک جمله بنویس که چه کاری باید انجام می‌شد.

en: Is there been between have and the past participle?
tr: have ile past participle arasında been var mı?
fa: بین have و اسم مفعول been آمده؟

en: would rather + someone else + past simple: I'd rather you didn't.
tr: would rather + başka biri + past simple: I'd rather you didn't.
fa: would rather + شخص دیگر + گذشته ساده: I'd rather you didn't.

en: No necessity: needn't + base verb.
tr: Gereklilik yok: needn't + yalın fiil.
fa: نبود ضرورت: needn't + فعل ساده.

en: had better + base verb, same form for every subject.
tr: had better + yalın fiil, her özne için aynı.
fa: had better + فعل ساده، برای همه فاعل‌ها یکسان.

en: would rather and had better take the bare verb: I'd rather stay, you had better leave, you'd better not forget, you needn't bring.
tr: would rather ve had better yalın fiil alır: I'd rather stay, you had better leave, you'd better not forget, you needn't bring.
fa: would rather و had better فعل ساده می‌گیرند: I'd rather stay، you had better leave، you'd better not forget، you needn't bring.

en: A friend is visiting your city for one day. Write one sentence of strong advice (had better) and one preference (would rather).
tr: Bir arkadaşın şehrini bir günlüğüne ziyaret ediyor. Bir güçlü tavsiye (had better) ve bir tercih (would rather) cümlesi yaz.
fa: دوستی یک روز به شهرت می‌آید. یک جمله توصیه قوی (had better) و یک جمله ترجیح (would rather) بنویس.

en: Is there no to after had better or would rather?
tr: had better veya would rather'dan sonra to yok mu?
fa: بعد از had better یا would rather، to نیامده؟

en: Past condition: had not + past participle.
tr: Geçmiş koşul: had not + past participle.
fa: شرط گذشته: had not + اسم مفعول.

en: Present/general condition: if I were... with a past result.
tr: Şimdiki/genel koşul: if I were... geçmiş sonuçla.
fa: شرط حال/کلی: if I were... با نتیجه گذشته.

en: Present result: would not be.
tr: Şimdiki sonuç: would not be.
fa: نتیجه حال: would not be.

en: Mixed conditional: past condition, present result: If I had studied (past perfect), I would be fluent now (would + verb). Present condition, past result: If I were braver, I would have said no.
tr: Karma koşul: geçmiş koşul, şimdiki sonuç: If I had studied (past perfect), I would be fluent now (would + fiil). Şimdiki koşul, geçmiş sonuç: If I were braver, I would have said no.
fa: شرطی ترکیبی: شرط گذشته، نتیجه حال: If I had studied (گذشته کامل)، I would be fluent now (would + فعل). شرط حال، نتیجه گذشته: If I were braver, I would have said no.

en: Write one mixed conditional about a decision in your past and how your life is different now because of it.
tr: Geçmişindeki bir karar ve bu yüzden hayatının şimdi nasıl farklı olduğu hakkında bir karma koşul cümlesi yaz.
fa: یک جمله شرطی ترکیبی درباره تصمیمی در گذشته‌ات و این‌که الان زندگی‌ات به‌خاطرش چطور فرق کرده بنویس.

en: Past perfect in the if-part, would + verb (present) in the result?
tr: if kısmında past perfect, sonuçta would + fiil (şimdi) var mı?
fa: در بخش if گذشته کامل و در نتیجه would + فعل (حال) آمده؟

en: Negative participle clause: Not + -ing.
tr: Olumsuz ortaç cümleciği: Not + -ing.
fa: جمله‌واره وجه وصفی منفی: Not + ‎-ing.

en: Passive meaning → past participle: Written.
tr: Edilgen anlam → past participle: Written.
fa: معنای مجهول ← اسم مفعول: Written.

en: Earlier action: Having + past participle.
tr: Daha önceki eylem: Having + past participle.
fa: کار قبلی: Having + اسم مفعول.

en: Participle clauses: -ing for the same time or cause (Feeling tired, ...), Having + past participle for an earlier action (Having finished, ...), past participle for passive (Built in 1920, ...). The subject must be the same in both parts, and no but after the comma.
tr: Ortaç cümlecikleri: aynı zaman ya da neden için -ing (Feeling tired, ...), önceki eylem için Having + past participle (Having finished, ...), edilgen için past participle (Built in 1920, ...). İki parçada özne aynı olmalı ve virgülden sonra but olmaz.
fa: جمله‌واره‌های وجه وصفی: ‎-ing برای هم‌زمانی یا علت (Feeling tired, ...)، Having + اسم مفعول برای کار قبلی (Having finished, ...)، اسم مفعول برای مجهول (Built in 1920, ...). فاعل در هر دو بخش باید یکی باشد و بعد از ویرگول but نمی‌آید.

en: Rewrite one thing you did today as a participle clause: Having ... , I ...
tr: Bugün yaptığın bir şeyi ortaç cümleciğiyle yeniden yaz: Having ... , I ...
fa: یکی از کارهای امروزت را به‌صورت جمله‌واره وجه وصفی بازنویسی کن: Having ... , I ...

en: Is the person doing both actions the same?
tr: Her iki eylemi de yapan kişi aynı mı?
fa: کسی که هر دو کار را انجام می‌دهد یکی است؟

en: Discourse markers are fixed chunks: On the one hand... On the other hand, That said, On balance, In other words, All things considered, By and large.
tr: Söylem belirteçleri sabit kalıplardır: On the one hand... On the other hand, That said, On balance, In other words, All things considered, By and large.
fa: نشانگرهای گفتمان عبارت‌های ثابت‌اند: On the one hand... On the other hand، That said، On balance، In other words، All things considered، By and large.

en: Write a short balanced opinion (3 sentences) about working from home, using On the one hand, On the other hand and On balance.
tr: Evden çalışma hakkında On the one hand, On the other hand ve On balance kullanarak kısa, dengeli bir görüş yaz (3 cümle).
fa: با On the one hand، On the other hand و On balance یک نظر کوتاه و متعادل (۳ جمله) درباره دورکاری بنویس.

en: Is each marker written as its full fixed phrase, with a comma after it?
tr: Her belirteç tam, sabit haliyle ve ardından virgülle mi yazıldı?
fa: هر نشانگر به‌صورت عبارت کامل و ثابت و با ویرگول بعدش نوشته شده؟

en: Keep to, drop the repeated verb: wasn't able to.
tr: to'yu tut, tekrar eden fiili at: wasn't able to.
fa: to را نگه دار و فعل تکراری را حذف کن: wasn't able to.

en: Substitution: I hope so / I think so, I hope not / I'm afraid not (not yes/no). Ellipsis: I can go if you can; she can cook and he can too; he wanted to, but couldn't.
tr: Yerine koyma: I hope so / I think so, I hope not / I'm afraid not (yes/no değil). Eksiltme: I can go if you can; she can cook and he can too; he wanted to, but couldn't.
fa: جایگزینی: I hope so / I think so، I hope not / I'm afraid not (نه yes/no). حذف: I can go if you can؛ she can cook and he can too؛ he wanted to, but couldn't.

en: Write a two-line mini dialogue: a yes/no question about your weekend and a short answer with so or not.
tr: İki satırlık mini bir diyalog yaz: hafta sonun hakkında bir evet/hayır sorusu ve so ya da not ile kısa bir cevap.
fa: یک گفت‌وگوی دوخطی بنویس: یک سؤال بله/خیر درباره آخر هفته‌ات و یک جواب کوتاه با so یا not.

en: Did you answer with so or not instead of repeating the whole sentence?
tr: Tüm cümleyi tekrarlamak yerine so ya da not ile mi cevapladın?
fa: به جای تکرار کل جمله، با so یا not جواب دادی؟

en: Past emphasis: did + base verb.
tr: Geçmiş vurgu: did + yalın fiil.
fa: تأکید در گذشته: did + فعل ساده.

en: He → does + base verb.
tr: He → does + yalın fiil.
fa: He ← does + فعل ساده.

en: Emphatic imperative: Do sit down.
tr: Vurgulu emir: Do sit down.
fa: امر تأکیدی: Do sit down.

en: Emphatic do carries the tense; the main verb stays bare: I did send it, she does like it, he did work hard (not did sent, does likes).
tr: Vurgulu do zamanı taşır; ana fiil yalın kalır: I did send it, she does like it, he did work hard (did sent, does likes değil).
fa: do تأکیدی زمان را نشان می‌دهد؛ فعل اصلی ساده می‌ماند: I did send it، she does like it، he did work hard (نه did sent، does likes).

en: Someone doubts that you did something this week. Write one sentence insisting that you did it.
tr: Biri bu hafta bir şey yaptığından şüphe ediyor. Yaptığında ısrar eden bir cümle yaz.
fa: کسی شک دارد که این هفته کاری را انجام داده‌ای. یک جمله بنویس و پافشاری کن که انجامش دادی.

en: Is the verb after did in its base form?
tr: did'den sonraki fiil yalın halde mi?
fa: فعل بعد از did ساده است؟

en: must → had to (or stays must for a general rule).
tr: must → had to (ya da genel kural için must kalır).
fa: must ← had to (یا برای قانون کلی must می‌ماند).

en: should does not change.
tr: should değişmez.
fa: should تغییر نمی‌کند.

en: With a past reporting verb, modals shift back: will → would, can → could, may → might, must → had to. should, could, might, would stay the same. She said she could finish it.
tr: Geçmiş aktarma fiiliyle modal'lar geri kayar: will → would, can → could, may → might, must → had to. should, could, might, would aynı kalır. She said she could finish it.
fa: با فعل نقل‌قول گذشته، فعل‌های کمکی عقب می‌روند: will ← would، can ← could، may ← might، must ← had to. should، could، might، would ثابت می‌مانند. She said she could finish it.

en: Report two things someone promised or allowed this month, with said or told me (will → would, can → could).
tr: Bu ay birinin söz verdiği ya da izin verdiği iki şeyi said ya da told me ile aktar (will → would, can → could).
fa: دو چیزی را که این ماه کسی قول داد یا اجازه داد با said یا told me نقل کن (will ← would، can ← could).

en: Did will and can become would and could?
tr: will ve can, would ve could oldu mu?
fa: will و can به would و could تبدیل شدند؟

en: "Had lost" looks back from an earlier past moment. Here you are talking about now.
tr: "Had lost" daha önceki bir geçmiş andan geriye bakar. Burada şimdiden bahsediyorsun.
fa: «had lost» از یک لحظه قبلی در گذشته به عقب نگاه می‌کند. اینجا درباره الان حرف می‌زنی.

en: "Was losing" is an action in progress in the past. You lose keys in one moment, and the result is now.
tr: "Was losing" geçmişte devam eden bir eylemdir. Anahtar bir anda kaybolur ve sonucu şimdi.
fa: «was losing» کاری در حال انجام در گذشته است. کلید در یک لحظه گم می‌شود و نتیجه‌اش الان است.

en: "I am lost" means you don't know where you are. It cannot take an object like "my keys".
tr: "I am lost" nerede olduğunu bilmemek demektir. "my keys" gibi bir nesne alamaz.
fa: «I am lost» یعنی راه را گم کرده‌ای. نمی‌تواند مفعولی مثل «my keys» بگیرد.

en: "Last summer" is a finished time. Have + past participle does not go with a finished time word.
tr: "Last summer" bitmiş bir zamandır. Have + V3, bitmiş bir zaman ifadesiyle kullanılmaz.
fa: «last summer» زمانی تمام‌شده است. have + قسمت سوم فعل با قید زمانِ تمام‌شده نمی‌آید.

en: "Have been" cannot go with a finished time like "last summer".
tr: "Have been", "last summer" gibi bitmiş bir zamanla kullanılmaz.
fa: «have been» با زمان تمام‌شده‌ای مثل «last summer» نمی‌آید.

en: "Go" is present, but "last summer" is in the past.
tr: "Go" şimdiki zamandır, ama "last summer" geçmişte.
fa: «go» زمان حال است، اما «last summer» در گذشته است.

en: "Since" needs a starting point (since May, since 2020). "Two years" is a length of time.
tr: "Since" bir başlangıç noktası ister (since May, since 2020). "Two years" bir süredir.
fa: «since» نقطه شروع می‌خواهد (since May، since 2020). «two years» یک مدت زمان است.

en: "From" usually comes with "to" (from May to June). It does not measure a length of time.
tr: "From" genelde "to" ile gelir (from May to June). Bir süreyi ölçmez.
fa: «from» معمولاً با «to» می‌آید (from May to June). مدت زمان را اندازه نمی‌گیرد.

en: "During" goes with an event (during the film). It does not say how long.
tr: "During" bir olayla kullanılır (during the film). Ne kadar sürdüğünü söylemez.
fa: «during» با یک رویداد می‌آید (during the film). نمی‌گوید چه مدت.

en: "For" goes with a length of time (for three days). "Monday" is a starting point.
tr: "For" bir süreyle kullanılır (for three days). "Monday" bir başlangıç noktasıdır.
fa: «for» با مدت زمان می‌آید (for three days). «Monday» نقطه شروع است.

en: "From" usually needs "to" or "until" (from Monday to Friday). Here there is no end point.
tr: "From" genelde "to" ya da "until" ister (from Monday to Friday). Burada bitiş noktası yok.
fa: «from» معمولاً «to» یا «until» می‌خواهد (from Monday to Friday). اینجا نقطه پایانی نیست.

en: "Ago" comes after a length of time (two days ago) and goes with the past simple.
tr: "Ago" bir süreden sonra gelir (two days ago) ve geçmiş zamanla kullanılır.
fa: «ago» بعد از مدت زمان می‌آید (two days ago) و با گذشته ساده به کار می‌رود.

en: In the "if" part we don't use "will", even when we talk about the future.
tr: "If" kısmında, gelecekten bahsederken bile "will" kullanmayız.
fa: در بخش «if» از «will» استفاده نمی‌کنیم، حتی وقتی درباره آینده حرف می‌زنیم.

en: "Would" is for imagined situations. This is a real possibility, with "will" in the other half.
tr: "Would" hayali durumlar içindir. Bu gerçek bir olasılık ve diğer yarıda "will" var.
fa: «would» برای موقعیت‌های خیالی است. این یک احتمال واقعی است و در نیمه دیگر «will» آمده.

en: "Left" is past. The sentence is about now and the future ("will catch").
tr: "Left" geçmiş zamandır. Cümle şimdi ve gelecekle ilgili ("will catch").
fa: «left» گذشته است. جمله درباره الان و آینده است («will catch»).

en: "Are being" describes behaviour right now. The happiness comes after the exam, in the future.
tr: "Are being" şu anki davranışı anlatır. Mutluluk sınavdan sonra, gelecekte gelir.
fa: «are being» رفتار همین الان را توصیف می‌کند. خوشحالی بعد از امتحان، در آینده می‌آید.

en: "Would" goes with an imagined "if" (if she passed). Here the "if" part is real: "passes".
tr: "Would" hayali bir "if" ile gelir (if she passed). Burada "if" kısmı gerçek: "passes".
fa: «would» با «if» خیالی می‌آید (if she passed). اینجا بخش «if» واقعی است: «passes».

en: "Be" alone has no tense. The result part needs a full verb about the future.
tr: "Be" tek başına zaman göstermez. Sonuç kısmı gelecekle ilgili tam bir fiil ister.
fa: «be» به‌تنهایی زمان ندارد. بخش نتیجه یک فعل کامل درباره آینده می‌خواهد.

en: "Must" is never followed by "to". Also, this sentence is friendly advice, not a rule.
tr: "Must"tan sonra asla "to" gelmez. Ayrıca bu cümle bir kural değil, dostça bir tavsiye.
fa: بعد از «must» هرگز «to» نمی‌آید. در ضمن این جمله یک توصیه دوستانه است، نه قانون.

en: "You have drink" is not English: "have" for duty needs another word before the verb.
tr: "You have drink" doğru değil: zorunluluk için "have", fiilden önce bir kelime daha ister.
fa: «You have drink» درست نیست: «have» برای اجبار قبل از فعل یک کلمه دیگر لازم دارد.

en: There is no "to" after a modal verb like can, must or might.
tr: Can, must, might gibi modal fiillerden sonra "to" gelmez.
fa: بعد از فعل‌های وجهی مثل can، must یا might کلمه «to» نمی‌آید.

en: "Should" is only advice. Driving on the left is the law, so advice is too weak.
tr: "Should" sadece tavsiyedir. Soldan gitmek bir yasa, tavsiye burada zayıf kalır.
fa: «should» فقط توصیه است. رانندگی از سمت چپ قانون است، پس توصیه کافی نیست.

en: "Must" is never followed by "to".
tr: "Must"tan sonra asla "to" gelmez.
fa: بعد از «must» هرگز «to» نمی‌آید.

en: "Drivers have drive" is not English: "have" alone cannot carry a rule.
tr: "Drivers have drive" doğru değil: "have" tek başına bir kural anlatamaz.
fa: «Drivers have drive» درست نیست: «have» به‌تنهایی قانون را نمی‌رساند.

en: "By the children" shows the window received the action. "Broke" makes the window do it.
tr: "By the children" camın eylemi aldığını gösterir. "Broke" ile cam eylemi yapan olur.
fa: «by the children» نشان می‌دهد شیشه کار را دریافت کرده. با «broke» شیشه انجام‌دهنده می‌شود.

en: After "was" we need the past participle, and "broke" is the past simple form.
tr: "Was"tan sonra V3 gerekir; "broke" ise V2 (geçmiş zaman) hâlidir.
fa: بعد از «was» قسمت سوم فعل لازم است، و «broke» شکل گذشته ساده است.

en: "Is breaking" is active and present. The window did not break anything, and the story is finished.
tr: "Is breaking" etken ve şimdiki zamandır. Cam bir şey kırmadı ve olay bitti.
fa: «is breaking» معلوم و حال است. شیشه چیزی را نشکست و ماجرا تمام شده.

en: Shoes cannot make anything. Someone did the action to the shoes.
tr: Ayakkabılar bir şey yapamaz. Eylemi ayakkabılara başkası yaptı.
fa: کفش‌ها نمی‌توانند چیزی بسازند. کسی آن کار را روی کفش‌ها انجام داده.

en: "Are making" means the shoes are doing the action right now.
tr: "Are making", eylemi şu anda ayakkabıların yaptığı anlamına gelir.
fa: «are making» یعنی کفش‌ها همین الان دارند کار را انجام می‌دهند.

en: Without a helper verb, "These shoes made in Italy" has no main verb.
tr: Yardımcı fiil olmadan "These shoes made in Italy" cümlesinin ana fiili yok.
fa: بدون فعل کمکی، «These shoes made in Italy» فعل اصلی ندارد.

en: "Which" is for things and animals. A doctor is a person.
tr: "Which" eşyalar ve hayvanlar içindir. Doktor bir insandır.
fa: «which» برای اشیا و حیوانات است. دکتر یک انسان است.

en: "What" cannot follow a noun to describe it ("the doctor what..." is wrong).
tr: "What" bir ismi tanımlamak için ondan sonra gelemez ("the doctor what..." yanlış).
fa: «what» نمی‌تواند بعد از اسم بیاید و آن را توصیف کند («⁨the doctor what...⁩» غلط است).

en: "Whom" is for the object (the doctor whom I met). Here the doctor does the action: treated me.
tr: "Whom" nesne içindir (the doctor whom I met). Burada eylemi doktor yapıyor: treated me.
fa: «whom» برای مفعول است (the doctor whom I met). اینجا دکتر انجام‌دهنده است: treated me.

en: "Who" is for people. A laptop is a thing.
tr: "Who" insanlar içindir. Dizüstü bilgisayar bir eşyadır.
fa: «who» برای آدم‌هاست. لپ‌تاپ یک شیء است.

en: "Whose" shows the owner (the man whose car...). It must be followed by a noun.
tr: "Whose" sahibini gösterir (the man whose car...). Arkasından bir isim gelmeli.
fa: «whose» مالک را نشان می‌دهد (the man whose car...). بعد از آن باید اسم بیاید.

en: "What" cannot follow a noun ("the laptop what I bought" is wrong).
tr: "What" bir isimden sonra gelemez ("the laptop what I bought" yanlış).
fa: «what» بعد از اسم نمی‌آید («the laptop what I bought» غلط است).

en: "Use to" without -d only appears after did or didn't (Did he use to...?).
tr: -d'siz "use to" sadece did ya da didn't'ten sonra gelir (Did he use to...?).
fa: «use to» بدون -d فقط بعد از did یا didn't می‌آید (Did he use to...?).

en: "Is used to" means "is familiar with" and it is present. He stopped smoking: this is an old habit.
tr: "Is used to" "alışkın olmak" demektir ve şimdiki zamandır. Sigarayı bıraktı: bu eski bir alışkanlık.
fa: «is used to» یعنی «عادت داشتن» و زمان حال است. او سیگار را ترک کرده: این عادتی قدیمی است.

en: "Uses to" does not exist. This form never takes -s.
tr: "Uses to" diye bir şey yoktur. Bu yapı asla -s almaz.
fa: «uses to» وجود ندارد. این ساختار هرگز -s نمی‌گیرد.

en: "Use to" without -d only appears after did or didn't (Did you use to...?).
tr: -d'siz "use to" sadece did ya da didn't'ten sonra gelir (Did you use to...?).
fa: «use to» بدون -d فقط بعد از did یا didn't می‌آید (Did you use to...?).

en: "Are used to" means "are familiar with" and is followed by -ing. "When we were kids" is an old habit.
tr: "Are used to" "alışkın olmak" demektir ve ardından -ing gelir. "When we were kids" eski bir alışkanlık.
fa: «are used to» یعنی «عادت داشتن» و بعدش -ing می‌آید. «when we were kids» عادتی قدیمی است.

en: "Were use to" is not English: this past-habit form has no "were".
tr: "Were use to" doğru değil: bu geçmiş alışkanlık yapısında "were" yoktur.
fa: «were use to» درست نیست: این ساختار عادت گذشته «were» ندارد.

en: "Enjoy" is never followed by "to" + verb.
tr: "Enjoy"dan sonra asla "to" + fiil gelmez.
fa: بعد از «enjoy» هرگز «to» + فعل نمی‌آید.

en: After "enjoy", the base verb alone is not possible ("she enjoys listen").
tr: "Enjoy"dan sonra fiilin yalın hâli tek başına gelemez ("she enjoys listen").
fa: بعد از «enjoy» شکل ساده فعل به‌تنهایی نمی‌آید («she enjoys listen»).

en: Two verbs with -s cannot follow each other: "enjoys listens".
tr: -s almış iki fiil art arda gelemez: "enjoys listens".
fa: دو فعل با -s نمی‌توانند پشت سر هم بیایند: «enjoys listens».

en: "Decide" is not followed by -ing.
tr: "Decide"dan sonra -ing gelmez.
fa: بعد از «decide» شکل -ing نمی‌آید.

en: After "decided", the base verb alone is not possible ("we decided take").
tr: "Decided"dan sonra fiilin yalın hâli tek başına gelemez ("we decided take").
fa: بعد از «decided» شکل ساده فعل به‌تنهایی نمی‌آید («we decided take»).

en: "Decided" is already the past verb. A second past verb cannot follow it directly.
tr: "Decided" zaten geçmiş zaman fiili. Hemen ardından ikinci bir geçmiş fiil gelemez.
fa: «decided» خودش فعل گذشته است. یک فعل گذشته دیگر نمی‌تواند مستقیم بعدش بیاید.

en: The main verb is "live", not "be". The tag repeats the helper of the main verb.
tr: Ana fiil "be" değil, "live". Soru eki, ana fiilin yardımcısını tekrarlar.
fa: فعل اصلی «live» است، نه «be». دنباله سؤالی فعل کمکیِ فعل اصلی را تکرار می‌کند.

en: A positive sentence usually takes a negative tag.
tr: Olumlu bir cümle genelde olumsuz bir soru eki alır.
fa: جمله مثبت معمولاً دنباله سؤالی منفی می‌گیرد.

en: The subject is "you", so the tag cannot use "it".
tr: Özne "you", bu yüzden soru eki "it" kullanamaz.
fa: فاعل «you» است، پس دنباله سؤالی نمی‌تواند «it» داشته باشد.

en: The sentence is already negative ("isn't"), so the tag is not negative too.
tr: Cümle zaten olumsuz ("isn't"), bu yüzden soru eki de olumsuz olmaz.
fa: جمله خودش منفی است («isn't»)، پس دنباله سؤالی دیگر منفی نمی‌شود.

en: "Does" is not in the sentence. The tag repeats the helper verb that is already there.
tr: "Does" cümlede yok. Soru eki, cümlede zaten olan yardımcı fiili tekrarlar.
fa: «does» در جمله نیست. دنباله سؤالی همان فعل کمکیِ موجود در جمله را تکرار می‌کند.

en: The subject is "she", so the tag cannot use "it".
tr: Özne "she", bu yüzden soru eki "it" kullanamaz.
fa: فاعل «she» است، پس دنباله سؤالی نمی‌تواند «it» داشته باشد.

en: "Is" keeps the speaker's present tense. After "said", the tense usually moves one step back.
tr: "Is" konuşanın şimdiki zamanını korur. "Said"den sonra zaman genelde bir adım geriye kayar.
fa: «is» زمان حالِ گوینده را نگه می‌دارد. بعد از «said» زمان معمولاً یک قدم به عقب می‌رود.

en: "Has been" changes the meaning (hungry for some time). The original sentence is simple: "I am hungry."
tr: "Has been" anlamı değiştirir (bir süredir aç). Asıl cümle basitti: "I am hungry."
fa: «has been» معنی را عوض می‌کند (مدتی است گرسنه). جمله اصلی ساده بود: «I am hungry.»

en: "She" takes a singular verb. "Were" goes with you, we and they.
tr: "She" tekil fiil alır. "Were", you, we ve they ile kullanılır.
fa: «she» فعل مفرد می‌گیرد. «were» با you، we و they می‌آید.

en: "Will" keeps the speaker's exact words. After "said", it usually moves one step back.
tr: "Will" konuşanın sözünü aynen korur. "Said"den sonra genelde bir adım geriye kayar.
fa: «will» عین کلمات گوینده را نگه می‌دارد. بعد از «said» معمولاً یک قدم به عقب می‌رود.

en: "Are going" needs "to" before "come", and it does not move the tense back.
tr: "Are going", "come"dan önce "to" ister ve zamanı geriye kaydırmaz.
fa: «are going» قبل از «come» به «to» نیاز دارد و زمان را به عقب نمی‌برد.

en: "Would" belongs in the result half, not in the "if" half.
tr: "Would" sonuç kısmına aittir, "if" kısmına değil.
fa: «would» مال نیمه نتیجه است، نه نیمه «if».

en: "Have" is a real present. With "would learn", the "if" part is imagined, so its tense moves back.
tr: "Have" gerçek bir şimdiki zamandır. "Would learn" varken "if" kısmı hayalidir, bu yüzden zamanı geriye kayar.
fa: «have» حالِ واقعی است. با «would learn» بخش «if» خیالی است، پس زمانش به عقب می‌رود.

en: "Will" does not go in the "if" half, and it does not match "would learn".
tr: "Will", "if" kısmına girmez ve "would learn" ile uyuşmaz.
fa: «will» در نیمه «if» نمی‌آید و با «would learn» هم‌خوان نیست.

en: "Lived" shows an imagined situation. "Will" is for real possibilities.
tr: "Lived" hayali bir durumu gösterir. "Will" gerçek olasılıklar içindir.
fa: «lived» موقعیتی خیالی را نشان می‌دهد. «will» برای احتمال‌های واقعی است.

en: "See" is a plain present fact. An imagined "if" needs an imagined result.
tr: "See" düz bir şimdiki zaman gerçeğidir. Hayali bir "if", hayali bir sonuç ister.
fa: «see» یک واقعیت ساده در زمان حال است. «if» خیالی نتیجه خیالی می‌خواهد.

en: After "would" comes the base verb, never the past form.
tr: "Would"dan sonra fiilin yalın hâli gelir, asla geçmiş hâli gelmez.
fa: بعد از «would» شکل ساده فعل می‌آید، هرگز شکل گذشته.

en: "Would helped" is not possible: after "would", a past participle cannot stand alone.
tr: "Would helped" olmaz: "would"dan sonra V3 tek başına duramaz.
fa: «would helped» ممکن نیست: بعد از «would» قسمت سوم فعل به‌تنهایی نمی‌آید.

en: "Will have" looks at the future. "Had told" is an imagined past.
tr: "Will have" geleceğe bakar. "Had told" hayali bir geçmiştir.
fa: «will have» به آینده نگاه می‌کند. «had told» گذشته‌ای خیالی است.

en: "Had" goes in the "if" half. The result half of an imagined past needs a different form.
tr: "Had", "if" kısmına gider. Hayali bir geçmişin sonuç kısmı başka bir yapı ister.
fa: «had» در نیمه «if» می‌آید. نیمه نتیجه در گذشته خیالی ساختار دیگری می‌خواهد.

en: "Studied" is for imagined present situations. "Would have passed" shows the whole sentence is about the past.
tr: "Studied" hayali şimdiki durumlar içindir. "Would have passed" bütün cümlenin geçmişle ilgili olduğunu gösterir.
fa: «studied» برای موقعیت‌های خیالیِ زمان حال است. «would have passed» نشان می‌دهد کل جمله درباره گذشته است.

en: "Would" goes in the result half, not in the "if" half.
tr: "Would" sonuç kısmına gider, "if" kısmına değil.
fa: «would» در نیمه نتیجه می‌آید، نه در نیمه «if».

en: "Has studied" connects to now. This is an imagined past that cannot change.
tr: "Has studied" şimdiye bağlanır. Bu, değiştirilemeyen hayali bir geçmiş.
fa: «has studied» به حال وصل می‌شود. این گذشته‌ای خیالی است که دیگر تغییر نمی‌کند.

en: "Is repaired" is a general fact. "At the moment" shows the work is happening now.
tr: "Is repaired" genel bir gerçektir. "At the moment" işin şu anda yapıldığını gösterir.
fa: «is repaired» یک واقعیت کلی است. «at the moment» نشان می‌دهد کار همین الان در جریان است.

en: "Was" is past. "At the moment" and "take the other street" are about now.
tr: "Was" geçmiş zamandır. "At the moment" ve "take the other street" şimdiyle ilgili.
fa: «was» گذشته است. «at the moment» و «take the other street» درباره الان هستند.

en: "Being repaired" needs a helper verb before it to make a sentence.
tr: "Being repaired", cümle olması için önünde bir yardımcı fiil ister.
fa: «being repaired» برای جمله شدن قبل از خودش فعل کمکی لازم دارد.

en: "Will delivered" is not English. The order receives the action, so a word is missing.
tr: "Will delivered" doğru değil. Siparişe bir şey yapılıyor, bu yüzden bir kelime eksik.
fa: «will delivered» درست نیست. کار روی سفارش انجام می‌شود، پس یک کلمه کم است.

en: "Is being to be" is not an English verb form.
tr: "Is being to be" İngilizcede bir fiil yapısı değildir.
fa: «is being to be» در انگلیسی ساختار فعلی نیست.

en: After "will" comes the base form of the verb, not -ing.
tr: "Will"den sonra fiilin yalın hâli gelir, -ing değil.
fa: بعد از «will» شکل ساده فعل می‌آید، نه -ing.

en: This is question order. A reported question uses the order of a normal sentence, and the tense moves back.
tr: Bu soru sırasıdır. Aktarılan soru normal cümle sırasını kullanır ve zaman geriye kayar.
fa: این ترتیب جمله سؤالی است. سؤالِ نقل‌قول‌شده ترتیب جمله عادی را دارد و زمانش به عقب می‌رود.

en: "Was it" is question order. A reported question uses normal sentence order.
tr: "Was it" soru sırasıdır. Aktarılan soru normal cümle sırasını kullanır.
fa: «was it» ترتیب سؤالی است. سؤالِ نقل‌قول‌شده ترتیب جمله عادی را دارد.

en: The order is right, but "asked" is past: the tense in the reported part usually moves one step back.
tr: Sıra doğru, ama "asked" geçmiş zaman: aktarılan kısmın zamanı genelde bir adım geriye kayar.
fa: ترتیب درست است، اما «asked» گذشته است: زمانِ بخش نقل‌شده معمولاً یک قدم به عقب می‌رود.

en: After "told him", the base verb alone is not possible.
tr: "Told him"den sonra fiilin yalın hâli tek başına gelemez.
fa: بعد از «told him» شکل ساده فعل به‌تنهایی نمی‌آید.

en: "Tell someone" is not followed by -ing.
tr: "Tell someone"dan sonra -ing gelmez.
fa: بعد از «tell someone» شکل -ing نمی‌آید.

en: After "that" you need a subject and a full verb. "That drink" is incomplete.
tr: "That"ten sonra bir özne ve tam bir fiil gerekir. "That drink" eksik.
fa: بعد از «that» فاعل و فعل کامل لازم است. «that drink» ناقص است.

en: "Must rained" is not possible. For a guess about the past, "must" alone is not enough.
tr: "Must rained" olmaz. Geçmişle ilgili bir tahmin için "must" tek başına yetmez.
fa: «must rained» ممکن نیست. برای حدس درباره گذشته، «must» به‌تنهایی کافی نیست.
